contract.coordinates: x*W/max(W,H), y*H/max(W,H), z as reported; missing -> 0 with mask 0

selection.objective: max(correct - wrong) s.t. unknown accept rate <= max_far
selection.fit_on: validation signers (known) + calibration-only unknown signs (val+train clips)

data: PopSign ASL v2.1 (Starner et al.), CC BY 4.0; https://signdata.cc.gatech.edu/
